skill.name: resume-tailor
skill.description: Customize resume for specific job postings while maintaining truthfulness
skill.summary: Tailor resume summaries, skills, and experience to job requirements while preserving factual claims.
skill.author: paramchoudhary

content.user_title: Tailor Your Resume to a Specific Job
content.value_statement: Generic resumes can hide experience that matters for a specific role. This skill aligns summaries, skills, and achievement bullets with job requirements while preserving truthfulness.
actual_capabilities: Rewrite professional summaries to emphasize experience relevant to a target position.
Reorder skills and incorporate job description keywords that accurately describe existing experience.
Prioritize relevant roles and achievement bullets while retaining employment dates.
Provide before-and-after bullet revisions and a summary of proposed changes.
Adapt resume emphasis for technical, management, startup, and large-company roles.
Suggest targeted version names and maintain tailoring notes for interview preparation.
limitations: Requires accurate resume details and target job requirements; it cannot independently verify your qualifications.
Directs users to run job-description-analyzer first; that separate skill is not included.
Estimated match scores are not validated applicant tracking system results or hiring guarantees.
Provides writing guidance and templates, without bundled PDF export, document parsing, or application submission tools.

use_cases.title: Target a First Professional Role
use_cases.description: Highlight relevant coursework, projects, and existing skills for a specific entry-level job.

use_cases.title: Refocus Transferable Experience
use_cases.description: Move relevant previous roles and achievements ahead of less relevant experience while keeping dates and claims accurate.

use_cases.title: Prepare Technical and Management Versions
use_cases.description: Create distinct resume versions that emphasize documented technical delivery or team leadership for different job postings.
use_cases.target_user: Experienced professionals pursuing multiple role types

prompt_templates.title: Revise a Professional Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Tailor my professional summary for [job title] using [resume] and [job description analysis]. Show the original and revised summaries. Use only supported qualifications.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: focus on one resume section.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Relevant Skills
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [current skills] with [job description analysis]. Reorder supported skills by relevance and suggest accurate keyword equivalents. List requirements my experience does not support separately.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: align skills without inventing expertise.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complete Tailoring Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a tailoring plan for [resume], targeting [job title] at [company], using [job description analysis]. Include summary revisions, skill ordering, and before-and-after experience bullets. Preserve dates, metrics, titles, and certifications.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate changes across the full resume.

prompt_templates.title: Create Two Targeted Versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [master resume] and [two job description analyses] to create separate technical and management versions. Document each change, keyword addition, and relevance decision. Suggest version filenames. Flag unsupported requirements and label any match scores as estimates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: maintain consistent facts across multiple applications.

output_examples.input: My listed skills are Microsoft Office, Python, SQL, and Data Visualization. The target role prioritizes SQL and Python.
output: Revised skills order: SQL, Python, Data Visualization, Microsoft Office.
Change summary: SQL and Python now appear first because they match the target priorities.

output_examples.input: My resume says I coordinated weekly project updates across five departments. The job description emphasizes stakeholder communication.
output: Before: Coordinated weekly project updates across five departments.
After: Coordinated weekly stakeholder communication across five departments through project updates.
The revision preserves the original frequency, scope, and responsibility.

best_practices: Provide a complete master resume and job description analysis before requesting targeted changes.
Verify every revised claim, metric, certification, and keyword against your actual experience.
Keep the master resume unchanged and record targeted versions with clear filenames and tailoring notes.
anti_patterns: Adding unsupported skills, titles, certifications, or metrics to match a posting.
Repeating keywords unnaturally or replacing readable explanations with keyword lists.
Treating estimated match scores as verified screening results or guaranteed interview outcomes.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your current resume, target job description, and job description analysis. Include verified achievements and any constraints on the changes.

faq.question: Does this skill add missing qualifications?
faq.answer: It can add accurate wording for existing experience. It explicitly prohibits inventing skills, certifications, job titles, experience, or metrics.

faq.question: Is job-description-analyzer included?
faq.answer: No. The instructions recommend running that separate skill first to identify requirements, keywords, and priorities.

faq.question: Can it create different versions of one resume?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports targeted versions with different summaries, skill ordering, and achievement emphasis while retaining the same underlying facts.

faq.question: Does it guarantee applicant tracking system compatibility?
faq.answer: No. It recommends preserving compatibility, but includes no validated screening engine. Any estimated match score is advisory.

faq.question: Does it export PDFs or submit applications?
faq.answer: No bundled export or submission tools are provided. Its filename examples describe version organization, not automated document creation or delivery.
